title: A.R.M.O.R. security policy of the server, told to the panel of an alarm node
description: What the server tells an ARMOR-ALARM panel about the security options an administrator set in Studio, on armor/alarm/{node_id}/policy (never retained, said again every 30 seconds so a panel that restarts learns it). config_hash: the panel binds its saved armed state to its zones and PIN and does not restore that state when either changed. zone_feed: the panel takes the Zigbee zone messages of the server (false: it ignores them). zone_feed_signature: the panel refuses a zone message that is not signed. A panel that has not heard the policy, or does not know it, keeps the behaviour it has: config_hash and zone_feed true, zone_feed_signature false.
